sentences.text:
Opposite Party
 Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Ravi Nath Verma

For the Petitioner(s) : Mr. S. K. Pandey-2, Adv.
 For the Opposite Party : Addl. P.P.
02 / 17.05.2016
This revision application is admitted for final hearing on limited question of sentence only.
Call for the L.C.R. from the court concerned.

Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner has been convicted under Section 16 (1) (a) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and sentenced to undergo SI for six months with fine of Rs. 1,000/- with default clause and on appeal preferred by the petitioner, the appellate court affirmed the judgment of conviction and order of sentence and after that the petitioner surrendered in the court below on 21.04.2016 and since then, he is in custody.
It was also submitted that since there is no chance of early hearing of this case and other co-convicts have already been released on bail, the petitioner deserves to be released on bail.
Learned counsel representing the State opposed the prayer.

Considering submissions of the counsels and the period in custody, I am inclined to release the petitioner, during the pendency of this revision application, on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Rupees ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of JM, 1st class, Hazaribag in G. Case No. 100 of 2008 (T. R. No. 627 of 2010) subject to payment of fine amounts as imposed by the court below.
Let this order be communicated through FAX at the cost of the petitioner.

(R.N.Verma, J.) Smita/-
